rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The INC's history says Sonia Gandhi was persuaded to take over the party leadership in 1998 and that 'On 6 April 1998, Sonia Gandhi was ratified as the Congress President at the AICC session in New Delhi', where her opening remarks set out her priorities.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same history says that on 15 May 1999 Sharad Pawar, P.A. Sangma and Tariq Anwar, in a letter to the party president, demanded that only 'natural born' citizens hold the highest offices, and that 'In response to this letter, Sonia Gandhi resigned from the post of party president.'
